findings.evidence: grep for `_def` in the two new files returns nothing; the only reductions available are `netCharge_sumElim`, `netCharge_chargedLine`, `eikonalCurrent_sumElim`, `eikonalCurrent_chargedLine`, all of which require the argument to already be a `Sum.elim` or a `chargedLine`.
findings.fix: Add untagged `eikonalCurrent_def (g L ℓ) : eikonalCurrent g L ℓ = ∑ i, ((L i).signedCharge / g (L i).momentum ℓ) • (L i).momentum := (rfl)`, `netCharge_def (L) : netCharge L = ∑ i, (L i).signedCharge := (rfl)` and `ChargedLeg.signedCharge_eq (L) : L.signedCharge = L.direction.sign * L.charge := (rfl)`, and use them in place of the by-name unfolds above. Leave them untagged: as `@[simp]` they would pre-empt `netCharge_sumElim`/`eikonalCurrent_sumElim` at the root, the same conflict already documented for `chargedLegs_eq_sumElim`.
findings.issue: `eikonalCurrent` and `netCharge` (ChargedLegs.lean:95) have no `*_def` restatement, so a consumer holding `eikonalCurrent g L ℓ` or `netCharge L` for a general family `L` has no lemma to reduce it and must unfold the definition by name. The files themselves demonstrate this: `rw [apply_eikonalCurrent_left, netCharge]` (Eikonal.lean:106), `simp only [eikonalCurrent, ...]` (Eikonal.lean:91, 99, 135, 149, 157, 162), `simp [netCharge, ...]` (ChargedLegs.lean:100, 115). `ChargedLeg.signedCharge` (ChargedLegs.lean:84) likewise only has `signedCharge_mk`, which does not fire on a projection `(L i).signedCharge`.

findings.evidence: Eikonal.lean:42-59 lists only `apply_eikonalCurrent_*`, `eikonalCurrent_conserved_*`, `eikonalCurrent_smul`, `apply_eikonalCurrent_eikonalCurrent`, `eikonalCurrent_sumElim`, `eikonalCurrent_chargedLegs*`; the three `chargedLine` theorems at L160/168/177 appear nowhere in the docstring.
findings.fix: Add the three `eikonalCurrent_chargedLine*` entries to the Main statements list.
findings.issue: The "Main statements" block (L40-59) omits three public theorems the file exports: `eikonalCurrent_chargedLine` (L160), `eikonalCurrent_chargedLine_conserved_left` (L168) and `eikonalCurrent_chargedLine_conserved_right` (L177). They are the per-line building blocks used to prove the advertised `eikonalCurrent_chargedLegs_conserved_*`, and the PR description lists them as deliverables.

findings.evidence: ChargedLegs.lean:32-34 names only `netCharge_sumElim`, `netCharge_chargedLine`, `DisKinematics.netCharge_chargedLegs`; `chargedLegs_eq_sumElim` at L128 is absent.
findings.fix: List `DisKinematics.chargedLegs_eq_sumElim` under Main statements, noting that it is the reduction that lets `netCharge_sumElim` and `eikonalCurrent_sumElim` apply.
findings.issue: The "Main statements" block (L32-34) omits `DisKinematics.chargedLegs_eq_sumElim` (L128), which is the `@[simp]` lemma that makes the whole `*_sumElim` API fire on `chargedLegs` — the central characteristic lemma of the file's headline definition, hidden from the module documentation.

summary: The compatibility surface is clean, the characteristic lemmas for `chargedLegs`/`chargedLine` are now present, and the simp annotations are coherent; two gaps remain: the two main definitions ship with no `*_def` restatement, so every consumer (including these files) must unfold them by name, and both module docstrings omit public results they expose.
